question: Treatment for scabies is

CHAIN: "Scabies" -> "caused by a mite infestation" -> "treatment needed to eliminate mites" -> "Erythromycin is an antibiotic" -> "not effective against mites" -> 80%

analysis: Scabies is primarily treated with topical scabicides. Benzene hexachloride (also known as BHC or lindane) is one of the agents that can be used for this purpose, although it is less commonly recommended due to safety concerns. Erythromycin, piperazine, and thiabendazole are not standard treatments for scabies.
